celulas/fundamentos-da-celula/cell-polar.descricaoOriginal: Polarity is a feature of cells in which their organelles are distributed asymmetrically in the cytoplasm. These triangular-shaped gland cells secrete digestive enzymes contained within secretory granules that are restricted to the apical (upper) regions of the cell. The blue-staining rough endoplasmic reticulum (RER) is the site of synthesis for these proteins and is present mostly in the basal regions. This segregation reflects the functional properties of the cells. Pancreas 1000x

base.alt: Fotomicrografia de Polarity — Células › Fundamentos da Célula › Polaridade celular › Polaridade celular 1.

overlays.explicacaoOriginal: Each pyramidal-shaped gland cell assembles with other similar cells into a spherical cluster. Each cell releases its product into a central space (lumen) at the apices of the cells. The lumen is continuous with a tubular duct that drains the cluster.

celulas/fundamentos-da-celula/cell-polar.descricaoOriginal: These cells in the pituitary gland are examples of non-polarized cells. Note how the secretory granules are homogenously distributed throughout the cytoplasm and not restricted to one region of the cell. This arrangement reflects the fact that these cells can release their secretory product from any site on the cell surface. Pituitary gland, 1000x.

celulas/fundamentos-da-celula/shapes/cel.descricaoOriginal: Cells that are in a fluid environment, e.g., blood, usually take on a spherical shape. In this blood smear, white blood cells are spherical. The red blood cells, in contrast, are bi-concave discs, which afford greater surface area for exchange of gases across the cell membrane. 1000x

celulas/fundamentos-da-celula/shapes/cel.descricaoOriginal: Squamous cells are highly flattened such that their width is much greater than their height. These images show a single layer of squamous cells surrounding the glomerulus of the kidney (left) and forming the lining of a small blood vessel (right). Single layers of squamous cells are often found at surfaces where rapid exchange of gases or solutes is required. 1000x, 1000x

This arrangement allows them to resist abrasion by sloughing off without damage to the underlying tissue. Note how the rounded basal cells become flattened as they reach the surface and how the shape of the nucleus conforms to the shape of each cell. 1000x

celulas/fundamentos-da-celula/shapes/cel.descricaoOriginal: In this kidney section, tubular structures are composed of cells with a wide range of shapes from squamous to cuboidal. Cuboidal cells are shaped like a cube with roughly equal height and width; their nuclei are usually spherical. Cuboidal cells often form tubes or tubules, a number of which are seen in this image. 1000x

celulas/fundamentos-da-celula/shapes/cel.descricaoOriginal: Columnar cells are shaped like columns and, as such, are much taller than they are wide. The oval nucleus conforms to the cell’s shape, with its long axis parallel to the height of the cell. The lateral cell boundaries are also visible in this section. This single row of columnar cells lines the digestive tract. Small intestine 1000x

celulas/fundamentos-da-celula/shapes/cel.descricaoOriginal: A stellate, or star-shaped nerve cell (multipolar neuron) has numerous long processes emanating from the cell body. The cytoplasm is filled with clumps of rough endoplasmic reticulum and polysomes called Nissl bodies. The numerous processes provide impulse conduction between multiple cells. Spinal cord 400x

celulas/fundamentos-da-celula/shapes/cel.descricaoOriginal: This composite image shows the morphology of spindle-shaped smooth muscle cells. As shown in the top panel, these cells are long, thin and taper at their ends. The nucleus is located midway along their length. This structure allows the cells to assemble into a tissue that forms compact sheets or layers, often forming the wall of hollow organs. The middle panel shows smooth muscle tissue in the wall of the digestive tract, the bottom panel is an illustration of that region. Top and middle panels 400x
